content:
Maya (Product): FinReg follow-up: they want a lightweight "Audit Evidence" quickflow in Console — show per-tenant cost by route and let auditors download a small set of redacted traces. Can we scope a tiny MVP?
Jun (Eng): Keep it minimal: estimated cost per request (no token lineage) + deterministic 1% sampling, redaction before storage.
Kai (SRE): Ops: hot index 7d, archive 60d for exports, default sample 1% tenant-opt-in. Pipeline async; drop on lag and emit metric.
Priya (Compliance): Export must include redaction manifest (rule ids + counts) and a signed attestation. No raw PII persisted.
Omar (Customer Success): I'll confirm FinReg's schema (CSV preferred) and ask about required attestations.
preview-bot: Uploaded mock: /assets/mocks/audit-quickflow-v1.png :white_check_mark:
Maya (Product): MVP cuts: 1) aggregated per-route cost tile, 2) stable sampled redacted traces export (max 500 traces/export), 3) tenant opt-in pilot, 4) simple modal UI. Launch if pilot can export signed bundle + redaction report and perf impact <2% p99.
Jun (Eng): Rough effort: 2 sprints for pilot (ingest hook + redaction microservice + export job) if we limit tenant scope. Risks: redaction false negatives, storage/cost blowout if sampling misset.
Kai (SRE): I'll produce retention/cost estimate and an ops checklist.
Maya (Product): Action items: Omar get FinReg schema (due Thu), Jun draft design doc (due Tue), preview-bot update mock (due Wed), Priya list compliance checks (due Wed). Sync after docs.
deploy-bot: Flag created: feature/audit-quickflow :white_check_mark:
